text: You can hear engines over Zaporizhzhia again. The enemy moved some of its aircraft here after Donetsk. How’s your partner doing after that last hundred?

I checked his upgrades while he had a rest. He used to tuck his head under my elbow when he heard that noise. Today he stretched his wings and gave me a look that said I was the one holding things up.
You’d better not keep him waiting. Tell him he’s cleared for takeoff and to look after those wings. You’ve got Kakhovka after Zaporizhzhia.
